name: Directly standardized synthetic group rate
interval_or_uncertainty: normal approximation from binomial age-specific variance
availability_rule: five positive age denominators and at least 16 statewide events
interpretation_limit: comparison index inside the fictional release only

name: Rate difference
numerator_or_summary: group standardized rate minus reference standardized rate
interval_or_uncertainty: conservative difference from group and reference interval endpoints
interpretation_limit: absolute difference depends on reference choice

name: Rate ratio
numerator_or_summary: group standardized rate divided by reference standardized rate
interval_or_uncertainty: conservative ratio from group and reference interval endpoints
availability_rule: both rates supported and reference rate positive
interpretation_limit: relative difference depends on reference choice and outcome direction

name: Summary absolute rate difference
reference_rule: one reference choice at a time
interpretation_limit: inspect pairwise results because the summary can hide direction

name: Summary rate ratio
reference_rule: one reference choice at a time
interpretation_limit: inspect pairwise results because the summary can hide group support

name: Field missingness percent
interpretation_limit: zero geography missingness is conditioned on tract linkage

name: Population and event representation shares
interpretation_limit: separate margins cannot support intersectional representation claims

name: Published tract-group crude rate
availability_rule: event count at least 16 denominator at least 100 and no complementary suppression
interpretation_limit: suppressed values are unavailable and no tract total is published
